label: Bible Study
prompt: Every man shall give as he is _____, according to the blessing of the LORD thy God which he hath given thee.
verse: Every man shall give as he is able, according to the blessing of the LORD thy God which he hath given thee.
note: The pilgrim-feast rule for giving — not a fixed price, but in proportion to how you've been blessed.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Unto Timothy, my own _____ in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.
verse: Unto Timothy, my own son in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.
note: Paul calls Timothy his own son in the faith — no blood relation, but family all the same.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the barbarous people shewed us no little _____: for they kindled a fire, and received us every one, because of the present rain, and because of the cold.
verse: And the barbarous people shewed us no little kindness: for they kindled a fire, and received us every one, because of the present rain, and because of the cold.
note: Shipwrecked and soaked, Paul's company found the islanders of Melita showed 'no little kindness' — and lit a fire.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And behold joy and gladness, slaying oxen, and killing sheep, eating flesh, and drinking wine: let us eat and drink; for to _____ we shall die.
verse: And behold joy and gladness, slaying oxen, and killing sheep, eating flesh, and drinking wine: let us eat and drink; for to morrow we shall die.
note: Jerusalem partied under siege; Paul quotes this line in 1 Corinthians 15.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Charity never _____: but whether there be prophecies, they shall fail; whether there be tongues, they shall cease; whether there be knowledge, it shall vanish away.
verse: Charity never faileth: but whether there be prophecies, they shall fail; whether there be tongues, they shall cease; whether there be knowledge, it shall vanish away.
note: 'Charity never faileth' — prophecies, tongues, and knowledge all have an expiry date; love doesn't.
